svg.title: Turn Eligible Accounts into Accepted Operator Revenue
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-accepted-lead-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: Turn Eligible Accounts into Accepted Operator Revenue; subtitle: Five operating stages connect account selection, outreach, qualification, routing, and recognized service fees.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Stage numbers indicate sequence, not conversion volume. Revenue means retainers and accepted-lead fees; client-funded advertising pass-through and the client's downstream sales remain excluded.; caption: A lead becomes billable only under the agreed acceptance definition. Keep eligibility evidence, qualification fields, routing timestamps, and acceptance outcomes attached to the same CRM record.; stages: label: Define the commercial target; value: Specify territory, buyer role, and qualifying need.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: The founder records service territory, excluded accounts, buyer authority, minimum project fit, and duplicate rules before sourcing contacts or quoting accepted-lead fees.; label: Establish contact eligibility; value: Check provenance, channel rules, and suppression status.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Record source, collection date, permitted purpose, and channel-specific evidence. Reconcile CRM suppression with every sending inbox and calling queue before activation.; label: Run identifiable outreach; value: Operate authenticated inboxes with truthful sender identity.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC on authorized domains. Use Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 within provider limits; investigate complaints instead of rotating inboxes to bypass restrictions.; label: Qualify and route; value: Confirm need, fit, ownership, and appointment availability.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use HubSpot or Salesforce required fields and Calendly availability to verify the buyer's request, assign an account owner, and prevent duplicate appointment billing.; label: Accept, invoice, and learn; value: Record acceptance evidence before recognizing lead fees.; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Apply the signed acceptance and dispute terms, invoice earned retainers and accepted units, and report rejection reasons by source. Feed poor-fit patterns back into targeting.
